description: Change how the business screens scam calls, or which numbers are never screened. mode: off, label (default; nothing is blocked) or screen (callers with a strong scam sign, such as a caller ID the carrier could not verify or a number already caught scamming, get a short screen that takes their name and reason instead of the normal line). Known customers and the team are never screened. allowlist replaces the whole list. Requires an admin of the business. The next call uses the change.

allowlist.description: Phone numbers never screened. Replaces the saved list. Up to 200.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token has exactly one accessible business)

dry_run.description: Validate and show the proposed settings without writing.

name: set_scam_screening
title: Set Scam Call Screening
